title: Missing access control on dispatcher dispatch() allows anyone to drain tokens from NFTMinter
description: All dispatcher dispatch() functions are external with only whenNotPaused modifier. NFTMinter grants type(uint256).max approval to dispatchers during registration. Any caller can call dispatch(nftMinterAddress, amount) to drain NFTMinter's tokens.
impact: Direct theft of all ERC20 tokens held by the NFTMinter contract. Tokens accumulated via Accumulator dispatcher can be stolen through any other registered dispatcher (Gather sends to recipient, Burner burns irreversibly).
recommendation: Add onlyMinter modifier to dispatch() in ATokenDispatcher base class
root_cause: dispatch() function has no caller restriction
